title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Full Stack Engineer Danışmanlığını yapmakta olduğumuz kurumsal iş ortağımız için, en az 8 yıl deneyimli Full Stack Engineer arayışımız bulunmaktadır. Görev Tanımı: .NET 8 ve üzeri teknolojiler kullanılarak frontend ve backend uygulamalarının geliştirilmesi ve mevcut uygulamaların iyileştirilmesi, React ve React Native kullanılarak web ve mobil uygulamaların frontend geliştirme süreçlerinin yürütülmesi, MediatR, CQRS ve Onion Architecture prensipleri doğrultusunda uygulama ve servislerin tasarlanması ve geliştirilmesi, Uygulama mimarisi ve teknik tasarım kararlarına katkı sağlanması, Uygulamaların performans, güvenlik, kod kalitesi ve sürdürülebilirlik standartlarına uygun şekilde geliştirilmesi, Mevcut uygulamalarda performans analizi, kaynak kullanımı optimizasyonu ve teknik iyileştirme çalışmalarının gerçekleştirilmesi, Yapay zekâ destekli geliştirme araçlarının kullanılmasıyla yazılım geliştirme süreçlerinin verimliliğinin artırılması. Aranan Nitelikler: .NET 8 ve üzeri teknolojilerle frontend ve backend geliştirme konusunda deneyimli, React ve/veya React Native ile frontend geliştirme deneyimine sahip, MediatR, CQRS ve Onion Architecture konusunda deneyimli, CI/CD süreçleri ve araçlarıyla çalışmış, SonarQube veya benzeri statik kod analiz ve kod kalitesi araçlarını kullanmış, Notification sistemleri ve mobil uygulamalara yönelik backend servis geliştirme konusunda deneyimli, WebLogic uygulama sunucusu konusunda deneyim sahibi, Transaction yönetimi, concurrency ve multithreading konularında bilgi ve deneyim sahibi, Uygulama mimarisi ve teknik tasarım süreçlerinde görev almış, Performans ve kaynak kullanımı optimizasyonu konusunda deneyimli, Git ve benzeri versiyon kontrol sistemleriyle çalışmış, Copilot gibi yapay zekâ destekli geliştirme araçlarını etkin şekilde kullanabilen, Analitik düşünme, problem çözme ve teknik hata analizi yetkinlikleri güçlü, Takım çalışmasına yatkın, iletişim becerileri güçlü, sorumluluk alabilen ve çözüm odaklı. "AVD Danışmanlık, Türkiye İş Kurumu'nun 1225 numaralı izin belgesi ile faaliyet göstermekted ir."

title: Python Backend Engineer, Data Infrastructure
description: Company Canaria is a technology startup providing high-quality, large-scale labor market data to the B2B market. Our mission is to power the next generation of solutions in recruitment, HR analytics, workforce planning, lead generation, healthcare, academic research, and finance by delivering the most comprehensive and accurate job market data available. Our advanced data mining, computing optimizations, and state-of-the-art NLP techniques let us process job market data at scale: over 1 billion unique job postings drawn from 200,000+ data sources, with 100+ fields per record. Our clients use this data to understand market trends, identify skill gaps, and connect people with the right opportunities. What You Will Do Write production Python daily. This is a Python-first role. Own the design and implementation of large-scale Python data pipelines (ingestion, parsing, cleaning, semantic deduplication, enrichment) over billions of job postings. Extend our in-house distributed crawling system: our own scheduling, queueing, proxy and session management, rendering, and anti-blocking layers, built and tuned by us rather than assembled from off-the-shelf frameworks. You will be adding new source integrations and making the core faster and harder to block. Design and operate the databases behind that pipeline across PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and Aerospike, at a scale where query plans and storage layout actually matter. Deploy your Python services with Docker on AWS/GCP and keep them running at scale. Ensure system quality through stress, integration, and end-to-end testing. Write clean, maintainable, well-documented code. Who You Are (Required) 3+ years in a paid role where Python was your primary language. 3+ of those years on production backend systems that were data-intensive (high-volume ETL, scraping, streaming, or large-scale batch processing). Completed Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a closely related computing field. Non-computing engineering degrees (mechanical, civil, mechatronics, EEE), statistics/mathematics degrees, associate degrees, and in-progress degrees do not meet this requirement. Comfortable in a Unix environment for both scripting and application development. Production experience with at least two named database systems, one relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and one NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, Aerospike, ClickHouse). Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure). Comfortable containerizing and deploying applications with Docker. Nice to Have Kubernetes in production. High-throughput key-value stores beyond the basics (Aerospike tuning, Redis clustering). RESTful API design and optimization. CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks. Monitoring and logging tools (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana). Big data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift). Benefits High-end laptop. Annual performance bonus. Work with global teams (US, EU). Founders and colleagues with FAANG and top-institution backgrounds. Access to powerful on-prem and cloud compute for research. Professional development and growth opportunities. Hiring Process First call about the role & expectations (15 mins) Python coding interview (1 hour) Technical interview (1 hour)

title: Backend Developer Intern
description: Backend Developer Intern At BLUESENSE AI Inc., we are building the future of personalized skincare. Our flagship product, Smart Beauty, is an AI-powered mobile platform that analyzes users' selfies to deliver custom skincare insights and product recommendations. Our mission is to merge AI, design, and dermatological science to create more intelligent, accessible, and empowering skincare routines for everyone, starting with a selfie. Now, we're growing our team and looking for a driven and detail-oriented Backend Developer Intern (Compulsory Internship) to help bring this vision to life. Position: Backend Developer Intern (Compulsory Internship) Email: hr@bluesense.ai http://www.bluesense.ai Location: ITU TEKNOKENT ARI-3 (ISTANBUL) / YTU YILDIZ TEKNOKENT DAVUTPASA (ISTANBUL) Duration: Minimum 4 weeks About Us We are a health-tech startup at the intersection of beauty and artificial intelligence. Our team includes AI engineers, backend and mobile developers, dermatology advisors, UX designers, and business leaders with a shared vision: to make intelligent skincare easy and accessible for everyone. As part of our team, you'll help build and improve the backend systems and APIs that power Smart Beauty's user experience, AI-powered skin analysis, personalized recommendations, and data-driven features. Your Role & Responsibilities As our Backend Developer Intern, you will help develop, test, and improve backend services, APIs, databases, and integrations that support our product. This is a hands-on role designed to give you practical experience in a startup software development environment. Backend Development Assist in developing and maintaining backend services and RESTful APIs Develop and integrate backend features using technologies such as C#, .NET / ASP.NET Core Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code following software development best practices Implement business logic and backend workflows for product features Debug existing code and help identify and resolve technical issues Database & Data Management Work with relational databases such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL Design, develop, and maintain database structures and relationships Write and optimize SQL queries Work with Entity Framework Core or similar ORM technologies Help ensure data consistency, security, and reliability API & System Integration Develop and test RESTful APIs for communication between backend, mobile, web, and AI services Integrate third-party services and external APIs when required Support the integration of AI/ML services with backend systems Work with authentication, authorization, and secure API practices Collaborate with frontend, mobile, and AI engineering teams to integrate backend functionality Testing, Deployment & Documentation Write and maintain unit and integration tests where applicable Help troubleshoot and improve application performance and reliability Assist with deployment and configuration of backend services on cloud platforms Use Git for version control and collaborative development Document APIs, technical implementations, and development processes clearly We are looking for someone who is curious, motivated, and eager to grow in a dynamic startup culture. Ideal Candidate: Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field Solid programming skills in C# and/or another backend programming language Basic knowledge of .NET / ASP.NET Core and RESTful API development Basic understanding of relational databases and SQL Familiarity with Entity Framework Core or similar ORM technologies Experience with Git and version control Basic understanding of software development principles and object-oriented programming Fluent in English A team player with strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn Nice to Have: Experience with ASP.NET Core Web API Knowledge of SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or other relational databases Experience with Entity Framework Core Knowledge of authentication and authorization concepts such as JWT Familiarity with Docker or cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Firebase Experience working with AI/ML APIs or LLM APIs Personal, academic, or open-source software projects (please share GitHub/portfolio links) Why Join BLUESENSE? Be Part of a Revolution - Build the backend infrastructure behind an AI-powered product that's redefining skincare. Work with Experts - Collaborate with AI engineers, backend and mobile developers, dermatology advisors, and a globally-minded team. Grow Your Career - Gain hands-on backend development experience and mentorship in a startup environment. Real-World Impact - See your code, APIs, and backend features go into a real product used by real people. Work Flexibly - Enjoy a remote, supportive setup across international time zones. Important Notes This is an unpaid, volunteer internship Only open to students who require a compulsory internship as part of their academic program Send your application (CV + short motivation + GitHub/portfolio link, if available) to: hr@bluesense.ai Type: Unpaid, Volunteer Internship

title: Tech Lead/Sr Backend (Go) Developer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Tech Lead/Sr Backend (Go) Developer based in Turkey. As a Tech Lead/Senior Backend Engineer, you will combine deep backend development expertise with hands-on ownership of modern cloud infrastructure. You will design and build scalable, resilient server-side systems while working closely with Kubernetes and containerized environments. A key focus of the role will be developing Kubernetes Operators and microservices using Go and the Operator SDK. You will contribute to high-availability architectures, disaster recovery capabilities, and long-term application maintainability. The role offers significant technical ownership, from architecture and development through deployment, scaling, and operational reliability. You will also provide technical leadership and help shape engineering practices across complex backend and infrastructure initiatives. Accountabilities Lead the design and development of scalable, high-performance backend applications with a strong focus on availability, reliability, maintainability, and operational resilience. Design and develop Kubernetes Operators using Go and the Operator SDK, implementing them as robust, production-ready microservices. Own backend solutions throughout their lifecycle, from technical architecture and implementation through deployment, scaling, monitoring, and ongoing improvement. Develop RESTful architectures and server-side services that can support complex workloads while maintaining clean, maintainable code. Design and implement high-availability architectures and disaster recovery strategies to improve system resilience and minimize operational risk. Manage and support containerized environments using Kubernetes and, where relevant, Docker Swarm, including deployment, scaling, health management, and operational troubleshooting. Work with cloud infrastructure to develop and maintain systems that manage and orchestrate cloud resources effectively. Provide technical leadership through architectural decisions, engineering guidance, code quality practices, and collaboration with other developers. Contribute to the evolution of backend architecture and engineering standards, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term technical health. Investigate complex technical issues across application and infrastructure layers and implement durable solutions. Collaborate across engineering and infrastructure disciplines to ensure backend services and underlying platforms operate reliably and efficiently. Requirements You have 7+ years of professional backend development experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on experience with Go. You have previous experience as a Tech Lead, Team Lead, or in a comparable technical leadership position. You have strong production experience working with Kubernetes and understand container orchestration in real-world environments. You have hands-on experience developing Kubernetes Operators using Go and the Operator SDK. You have strong backend architecture skills, including experience designing RESTful services, microservices, and highly available systems. You understand principles of scalability, resilience, disaster recovery, containerization, and production system reliability. You have experience with AWS and, ideally, a proven track record of developing and maintaining Operators that manage AWS resources. Experience with GCP or Azure is also valuable and demonstrates broader cloud infrastructure knowledge. You are proficient in modern server-side development and may have additional experience with technologies such as Node.js, Python, or Rust. You are comfortable working across application and infrastructure layers and can bridge backend engineering with cloud-native operations. You demonstrate strong architectural judgment, problem-solving ability, and a pragmatic approach to building maintainable systems. You communicate effectively, can guide technical discussions, and are comfortable taking ownership of complex engineering initiatives. You are able to balance hands-on development with technical leadership and collaboration across engineering teams. Benefits Opportunity to take on a senior technical leadership role combining backend engineering and cloud infrastructure. Hands-on work with Go, Kubernetes, Operator SDK, microservices, and modern cloud platforms. Significant ownership over architecture, implementation, deployment, and long-term system reliability. Opportunity to design and operate highly available systems with disaster recovery capabilities. Exposure to complex cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes-based automation. Opportunity to influence engineering standards, architecture, and technical direction. Work on technically challenging systems where scalability, resilience, and maintainability are core priorities. Exposure to multiple cloud environments, including AWS, GCP, and Azure. Opportunity to combine individual technical contribution with mentorship and technical leadership. Remote-friendly opportunity based in Slovenia, offering the flexibility of working within a modern distributed engineering environment.
